title: Krull dimension does not increase on an open subspace
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $U'\subseteq U\subseteq X$ be open subsets, each with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology]. Then $\dim(U')\leq\dim(U)$ for the Krull dimensions of these topological spaces [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].

source.place: Topology, Section 'Krull dimension', remark immediately after Definition 0055 (label definition-Krull), lines 1421-1425: if U' subset U subset X are open then dim(U') <= dim(U)
